description: Finds the stops of the Tbilisi Transport Company (bus stops, metro stations, cable car stations) by name or stop code, in Georgian or English. Use the stop id of the result with transit_list_arrivals or transit_get_timetable.

kind.description: Only stops of this kind: bus, metro, or cable_car. Empty gives every kind.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of stops, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

query.description: A stop name or a stop code, in Georgian or English.

name: transit_search_stops

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the stops, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

stale.description: True when the TTC did not answer and the server returns stops it read before.

stops.description: The matching stops, best match first.

code.description: The number on the sign of a bus stop. Absent for a station of metro or cable car.

id.description: The stop id, for example 1:1000. Every transit tool that takes a stop accepts it.

kind.description: bus, metro, or cable_car. A minibus stops at a bus stop.

lat.description: The latitude of the stop, in degrees.

lon.description: The longitude of the stop, in degrees.

title: Search the stops of Tbilisi
